purpose: Canonical shrine, pilgrimage, route and temporal-association layer for Explore, reusing shared Place identities and Calendar-owned temporal semantics.
invariants: Shared Place owns physical location, address and map identity; Shrine owns devotional and historical identity.
A shrine is not a TLM venue and a nearby traditional community is not associated with a shrine without an explicit evidence-backed bridge.
A pilgrimage is a devotional journey identity, not a calendar event, Mass schedule or route geometry.
A pilgrimage route may remain documented but unmapped until source-backed geometry or canonical waypoints exist.
Calendar is the sole owner of recurring liturgical dates and moveable-date calculation.
Temporal links use semantic Calendar keys and must not duplicate month/day or Easter-offset calculations in this corpus.
An observed source event may support a temporal association but does not become the recurrence engine.
Customs Atlas attestations may point to a canonical Place only after that Place exists in the shared Geography registry.
Shrine history, apparition/prodigy narratives and devotional associations must remain source-attributed and must not be promoted into doctrinal or canonical claims beyond the evidence.
Stable shrine, pilgrimage and route ids survive source refreshes and current-event changes.

releaseGates.placeIdentity: Every shrine requires a canonical place_id present in EXPLORE_GEOGRAPHY_SOT_V1.
releaseGates.provenance: Every shrine, pilgrimage, route and temporal link requires source provenance.
releaseGates.routeSafety: MAPPED routes require source-backed geometry or canonical waypoint ids; documented text alone remains DOCUMENTED_UNMAPPED.
releaseGates.calendarOwnership: PENDING/BOUND Calendar links require a semantic calendar key and may not contain date, month, day, Easter-offset or private recurrence fields.
releaseGates.associationSafety: No Directory venue/community relationship may be inferred from distance or shared locality.
releaseGates.customPromotion: A Customs Atlas PLACE_PENDING record may be promoted to PLACE only after its canonical shared Place exists.
